defects.what: The flag being sewn is blue over red with a plain white diamond in the middle and no hoist triangle, sun or stars, so it is not the Philippine flag.
The shop signs seen through the left window and on the right window frame are CJK-style characters, which do not belong in a Philippine scene.
The woman under the umbrella has three hands (a raised fist, a hand at her waist and a hand out to the right), and no hand holds the umbrella.
The document fills the frame with large rows of unreadable pseudo-handwriting.
The paper being signed shows several lines of large pseudo-script in the middle of the frame.
The note held in the center of the frame carries lines of gibberish letters.
The papers on the table under the man's pen carry small rows of pseudo-text.
Small plaques beside the church doors and a decal on the scooter's side panel show tiny glyphs.
The glowing clock rings behind Indio carry rows of letter-like marks around the dial edges.
A few small letter-like marks sit on the map near the top-left coastline.
Usman has both ears folded instead of one folded ear.
The dog walking beside Indio wears a thin red collar instead of Usman's red kerchief.
Indio wears a collared shirt open at the chest and has no bronze medallion.
